summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics filed a 6-K furnishing an October 2, 2026 press release disclosing Nasdaq Staff's October 1 determination that the company failed to regain compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(2)'s $35 million minimum market value of listed securities by the September 29, 2026 cure deadline. The company intends to request a Nasdaq Hearings Panel appeal, which stays suspension and any Form 25-NSE filing pending decision; shares and warrants (NRSN, NRSNW) continue trading. Separately, Nasdaq confirmed regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule after a 1-for-20 reverse split. Watch Panel exception odds and delisting risk.
